title: 2 Hour Walking Tour in Downtown Quebec City
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This two-hour tour, led by a knowledgeable local guide, will teach you about various cultures and historical periods. You will enjoy yourself in addition to learning. In addition to having the richest history in Canada, Quebec City has one of the most amazing histories in the entire world.
